sentences.text: Team Fortress 2 -LRB- TF2 -RRB- is a team-based multiplayer first-person shooter video game developed and published by Valve Corporation .	Valve Corporation	Valve Corporation	multiplayer	Multiplayer video game	first-person shooter	first-person shooter	video game	video game
It is the sequel to Team Fortress , the 1996 mod for Quake and its 1999 remake , Team Fortress Classic .	mod	Mod (video gaming)	Quake	Quake (video game)	Team Fortress Classic	Team Fortress Classic

It was released as part of the video game bundle The Orange Box in October 2007 for Microsoft Windows and the Xbox 360 .	Microsoft Windows	Microsoft Windows	Xbox 360	Xbox 360	The Orange Box	The Orange Box	video game	video game	bundle	Product bundling#Bundled software
A PlayStation 3 version followed in December 2007 .	PlayStation 3	PlayStation 3
The game was released for Windows as a standalone entry in April 2008 , and was updated to support OS X in June 2010 and Linux in February 2013 .	OS X	OS X	Linux	Linux
It is distributed online through Valve 's digital retailer Steam , with retail distribution being handled by Electronic Arts .	Electronic Arts	Electronic Arts	Steam	Steam (software)

In Team Fortress 2 , players join one of two teams comprising nine character classes , battling in a variety of game modes including capture the flag and king of the hill .	capture the flag	capture the flag	king of the hill	King of the Hill (game)
The development is led by John Cook and Robin Walker , creators of the original Team Fortress .	Robin Walker	Robin Walker (game designer)
Announced in 1998 , the game once had more realistic , militaristic visuals and gameplay , but this changed over the protracted nine-year development .
After Valve released no information for six years , Team Fortress 2 regularly featured in Wired News annual vaporware list among other ignominies .	Wired News	Wired News	vaporware	vaporware

The finished Team Fortress 2 has cartoon-like visuals influenced by the art of J. C. Leyendecker , Dean Cornwell , and Norman Rockwell , and uses Valve 's Source game engine .	Source	Source (game engine)	cartoon	cartoon	J. C. Leyendecker	J. C. Leyendecker	Dean Cornwell	Dean Cornwell	Norman Rockwell	Norman Rockwell	Source game engine	Source (game engine)
Team Fortress 2 received critical acclaim for its art direction , gameplay , humor , and use of character in a multiplayer-only game .	multiplayer	Multiplayer video game
Valve continues to release new content , including maps , items and game modes , as well as community-made updates and contributed content .
In June 2011 , it became free-to-play , supported by microtransactions for in-game cosmetics .	free-to-play	free-to-play	in-game cosmetics	Virtual goods
A ` drop system ' was also added and refined , allowing free-to-play users to periodically receive game equipment and items by use of a random number generator .	free-to-play	free-to-play

Though the game had a unofficial competitive scene for many years , support for official competitive play through ranked matchmaking and an overhauled casual experience was added in July 2016 .	ranked matchmaking	Matchmaking (video games)
